name: Minmetals New Energy Materials (Hunan) Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Minmetals New Energy Materials (Hunan) Co., Ltd. Class A primarily focuses on the development, manufacturing, and distribution of essential materials for various types of batteries. Its comprehensive product portfolio encompasses diverse precursor materials and a range of cathode materials. Specifically, this includes multi-element cathode compounds, cathode materials for lithium-ion batteries (such as lithium cobalt oxide and other related products), and components for nickel-hydrogen batteries. The company also provides advanced ternary materials optimized for both high energy density and power output applications. Established in 2002, its operations are based in Changsha, China.
